verifier.question: 663 found an instrument that answers, confidently, a question it cannot see.  How many instruments stand on that blind spot, and what does it cost today?

mustBeTwoLayered.why: the first version scanned only the Python AST and found zero. 654's AST census counted `.click()` on the Python side; `document.elementFromPoint` lives INSIDE a JS string constant, so the instrument is in the string.

census.weakMetric: 「payload mentions pointer-events」 is NOT 「the call is guarded」: 659's FORCE_PE_JS sets it rather than reads it. This batch claims only the former.

theCost.theZero: in every covered cell the hit test still returns the control or its own icon, OR the control's occlusion is already on record in 658's occludedKeys

exceptionsNamed.ancestor container: 632's 'the coverer is often a container, not a leaf', detected as hitContainsControl
exceptionsNamed.on-record families: 658's occludedKeys — the scene-prompt family that 659 and 660 closed-formed

1280x1150.why: 658 already recorded this control as occluded, and 659/660 closed-formed the scene-prompt family

1280x720.why: 658 already recorded this control as occluded, and 659/660 closed-formed the scene-prompt family

theCost.admissibilityIsCrossBatch: a non-self hitter is admissible iff the control's own data attribute appears in 658's occludedKeys. That is the accumulated record, not a whitelist this batch wrote.
theCost.scope: the zero covers 'what is AT this point'. It does NOT cover 'what is PAINTED here': all 22 elements are invisible to any hit-test-based criterion, and they include the playhead, the aspect frame and the bottom-bar host.

detail.theFirstRunFoundNothing: and that is not a null result -- it is a fact about where the instrument lives
detail.rule: a call-site census over a criterion corpus has to count the Python side (how often a payload is evaluated) and the JS side (how many hit tests are in it) separately

the-census-has-to-be-two-layered-and-tha.note: 654's AST census was right for `.click()` and wrong for this

detail.whatARefusalLooksLike: a returned field whose value can say 'this instrument cannot see the target' -- 663's `state`
detail.whatThisDoesNotClaim: that the other 20 files have a bug. 'Mentions pointer-events' and 'guards the call' are different claims and only the first is measured here.
detail.theConsequence: the mechanism exists and is unique; the population it would fire on is measured in the next checks; nobody else uses it.

of-the-hit-test-call-sites-only-one-payl.note: a gate that only one instrument walks through is not yet a criterion

detail.whyItMatters: 13 of 22 carry no data-director attribute, so even a criterion that wanted to refer to them by name could not -- the naming gap is part of the blind spot, not beside it

the-blind-population-is-22-elements-and-.note: an instrument that cannot see it and a name that cannot address it are the same gap twice

detail.playhead: the only mark on the timeline that says where 'now' is, and it is pointer-events:none -- no hit-test-based criterion can see it
detail.bottomBar: the host div carries the attribute but not the clicks; only its children are hit-testable
detail.scoped: these are named as MEMBERS OF THE BLIND SET, not as defects. They are click-through layers, which is what they are for.

the-blind-population-includes-the-playhe.note: invisible to a click test does not mean invisible on screen

detail.everyOtherCellSelfOrDescendant: in all covered cells the hit test returns the control or a descendant, i.e. the control is still clickable
detail.admissibilityTest: structural and CROSS-BATCH, not a string whitelist: ancestor hitter = 632; control attr present in 658's occludedKeys = 658/659/660; hitter is 收起属性 = 662. Anything else is a NEW occlusion and fails here.

1280x720.why: 658 already recorded this control as occluded, and 659/660 closed-formed the scene-prompt family

exceptions.收起属性: 662's in-case defect, already attributed and closed-form'd
exceptions.ancestor container: 632's 'the coverer is often a container, not a leaf' — measured as `hitContainsControl`, not matched by text
exceptions.scene-prompt family: 658 recorded `data-director-scene-prompt-input|描述想搭建的场景` as occluded at both 720 and 1150, and 659/660 gave it the W >= 1510 rule. The hitter here is a TRANSPARENT 280px inspector column (backgroundColor rgba(0,0,0,0)) — hit-testable though invisible, which is why no painting-based criterion ever named it.

detail.theCaseThatAlmostSlippedThrough: the scene-prompt input's coverer is transparent, so it is invisible to any PAINT-based reading and only shows up under a hit test
detail.whyThisIsWorthRecording: an empty set is not evidence -- but a measured zero with its scope written down is different from an unrecorded one, and this one is falsifiable by the next batch

no-new-occlusion-hides-behind-the-pointe.note: 空集不算证据；但量到的零和没记录不是一回事

detail.population: 22 elements in the open desk, of which the 3 the gate fired on are the ones sitting at a probed overlay's centre
detail.theGap: mechanism done, population measured, and no second instrument uses it. Turning that into a shared criterion is a `只增不改` change with a mechanical zero-regression proof, which this batch did NOT do and does NOT claim.
